description:
A satellite imagery map illustrating the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Protected Areas (PA) status product for 2021, showing examples within selected Natura 2000 (N2K) sites. The map is divided into two panels, displaying different geographic areas, likely within a European landscape characterized by forests, agricultural fields, and a river network.

The base layer is high-resolution satellite imagery depicting detailed land cover/land use (LCLU).
Red lines outline the boundaries of Natura 2000 sites, serving as contextual information.
Yellow lines represent the CLMS PA status layer, highlighting specific Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) status features identified within or adjacent to the protected areas.

The left panel presents a wider view, showing several distinct, relatively large Natura 2000 sites (red outlines) primarily encompassing forested areas. A major river flows through the bottom. Numerous smaller, irregularly shaped yellow polygons, representing the LCLU status, are visible both within and outside the red Natura 2000 boundaries, often highlighting specific patches of land or features.
The right panel shows a more magnified view of a different area, characterized by dense forest cover and agricultural mosaics. Here, the red Natura 2000 boundaries are more intricate and branching. The yellow lines representing the CLMS PA status product are predominantly elongated and curvilinear, often tracing linear landscape features or specific land cover types.

The image serves as an example of how the CLMS PA status layer (yellow features) delineates LCLU status, in relation to, but distinct from, the formal Natura 2000 site boundaries (red outlines) for the 2021 reference year.
